OwnerWorkspace.title: OwnerWorkspace
OwnerWorkspace.description: Private career management workspace strictly owned by the single authorized user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

payloadJson.description: Serialized private workspace state (profile, CV, offers, Kanban, Gmail log, 10-day plan)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update

PublicShareSnapshot.title: PublicShareSnapshot
PublicShareSnapshot.description: Sanitized public portfolio and company-specific share token metadata without private PII.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner who created this share link

isActive.description: Whether the share link and public web are currently enabled

requiresPin.description: Whether access requires a password/PIN verification

pinCode.description: Optional access code (empty string if not required)

allowCvDownload.description: Whether the authorized public CV can be downloaded from this link

publicProfileJson.description: Sanitized public profile and authorized CV summary (no postal address or private notes)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of creation or update

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Stores the private EMPLEO 10 workspace for the authenticated owner.

/public_shares/{token}.description: Stores sanitized company-specific shareable web snapshots accessible by token.
